programme.desc: I en flydende eremitbolig midt i den koreanske vildmark guider en gammel munk en dreng gennem livets faser. Da drengen konfronteres med begær og vold, sættes hans visdom på prøve. En poetisk fortælling om balance, livscyklus og menneskelig indsigt.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Teenagerne Eddie og Amber vokser op i en lille irsk by i løbet af 1990'erne. Alle har mistanke om at de er homoseksuelle, og hver dag er en kamp. De mødes og lader som om og indser at et opdigtet forhold kan være mindst lige så kompliceret som et rigtigt.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Den hurtigtsnakkende Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) har udset sig Newage-guruen dr. Sinja. Men efter et mystisk Bodhi-træ dukker op i hans have, indser Jack, at han hellere må forbedre sig, før det sidste blad falder af træet, ellers er han færdig.

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: En storm er på vej. Ingen kan forudsige det. Ingen kan måle dens størrelse. Nu bliver en familie nødt til at overleve den. Og ingen kan søge ly fra stormen, ingen kommer ind fra kulden.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: Mens Tim drømte om at arbejde for justitsministeriet, ønskede Peter at blive magtfuld politiker... for enhver pris.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: New Yorker-parret Josh og Cornelia er begge i 40’erne. Alderskrisen kradser, så da de møder et ungt hipster-par, Jamie og Darby, skiftes parmiddage ud med rulleskøjter, jazzhat og hip-hop-timer.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk aften i deres afsides hus vågner Emma lænket til sin døde mand. Hun er fanget, afskåret fra omverdenen og må kæmpe mod lejemordere for at undslippe sin mands forskruede plan.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Tre floder at krydse
programme.desc: Ifølge lokale munke er den berømte Jadekejserinde skjult i den dal, der vil blive oversvømmet, når Three Rivers Dammen åbner sine sluser.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mistet kontakt
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og milliardæren Rod Thorson hopper med faldskærm ned i Myanmars jungle for at redde et hold af relikviejægere, som Thorson har hyret til at finde en gammel offerskål.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Voodoo-korset
programme.desc: Da to universitetsstuderende, der er på sporet af det haitianske Utu-kors, forsvinder i New Orleans, tager Sydney og Nigel ned i bayouen for at finde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: romersk ferie
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er på tur, så Claudia beslutter sig for at hjælpe Sydneys ven Roger med at finde Julius Cæsars rustning, men hun har ikke talent for at jage relikvier.

programme.title: Andromeda: Enfluernes dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drivkraft, men de bliver snart til zombier, der styres af et hive-mind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Rick's On It

programme.title: RENO 911!: Spanish Mike Comes Back

programme.title: RENO 911!: Son of a Chechekevitch

programme.title: The Roast of Alec Baldwin

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Beverly D'Angelo, Sally Struthers, Melissa George
programme.desc: Beverly D'Angelo invokes Cass Elliot's spirit in her new home; Sally Struthers is visited by the apparition of a woman who fell tragically to her death in her home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Loretta Lynn
programme.desc: Country music superstar Loretta Lynn, the "Queen of Country," invites viewers into her legendary, and HAUNTED, Tennessee estate. In this exclusive and highly personal special.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: En kronik om det tragiske kærlighedsforhold mellem den amerikanske digter Elizabeth Bishop og den brasilianske arkitekt Lota de Macedo Soares.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: Mus I Eget Hus
programme.desc: De uheldige brødre Lars og Ernie Smuntz er ikke særligt imponerede over det faldefærdige, gamle herskabshus, de arver, indtil de opdager, at deres forfaldne ejendom faktisk er flere millioner værd.

programme.title: Face The Music
programme.desc: Dramakomedie med Molly Ringwald og Patrick Dempsey. Et fraskilt par, der engang skrev sange sammen, bliver hyret til at producere en sang til en ny film. Kan de lægge deres problemer til side og skabe et mesterværk?

programme.title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
programme.desc: Elvis portrays a pilot who runs a local charter helicopter service on the beautiful island of Kauai. A possible suspension of Elvis' pilot's license threatens to destroy his charter company along with all of his financial assets.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Efter at have dræbt en mand i selvforsvar bliver en ung kvinde afpresset af et vidne til mordet.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen spiller en amerikansk racerkører, som deltager i 24 TIMERS LE MANS, i denne hurtige og voldsomme originale film. Filmen er optaget forskellige steder på Le Mans-banen og byder på imponerende bilulykke-stunts og hæsblæsende action.

programme.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
programme.desc: En motorcyklist påbegynder et liv med kriminalitet for at kunne forsørge sønnen, som han ikke vidste, han havde. Han bliver i mellemtiden forfulgt af en idealistisk politimand.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie er en marketingchef, som vender tilbage til sin hjemby, da hun uventet bliver værge for sin niece og nevø. Mens hun er der, genoptager hun kontakten med Cooper, hendes ungdomskæreste.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himlen er der nu tre
programme.desc: Skaberens motor er i stand til at omskrive universet efter ejerens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må få fat i den, før nogen med mørke planer får fat i den.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Hodgepodge

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jumping the Shark

programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er Whoopi Goldberg og Anthony Jeselnik.

programme.title: The Roast of Bob Saget
programme.desc: I hver udgave af "The Roast of" bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Den aggressivt venlige skuespiller fra "Hænderne Fulde" og "Sjov og spas".

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Thing About Machines
programme.desc: Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programme.desc: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programme.desc: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programme.desc: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programme.desc: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programme.desc: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Dyan Cannon, Wendi McLendon-Covey, Quinton Aaron, Bridget Marquardt

programme.title: REC 2
programme.desc: En bygning er satt i karantene på grunn av en dødelig, ukjent virus. Kommer noen levende ut?

programme.title: The Jolly Monkey
programme.desc: For 40 år siden forsvant familier i nærheten av det isolerte Jolly Monkey-motellet. I dag vender eiernes familie tilbake for å diskutere hva de skal gjøre med stedet. Én etter én blir de drept av noen utkledd som motellets maskot og må flykte.

programme.title: Fredag den 13ende del III
programme.desc: Etter å ha oversett Camp Crystal Lakes blodige historie, blir de én etter én ofre for den gale Jason, som jager dem nådeløst...

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Wax Magic
programme.desc: An eccentric wax sculptor and his wife tour with a carnival. Not so coincidentally, a series of ax murders follow the carnival and the Hall of Horrors wax museum the sculptor runs.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Better Off Dead
programme.desc: A doctor is trying to develop a cure for a childhood syndrome lending towards hyper violence. Due to his mistake, his daughter was inadvertently infected with the disease from a contaminated needle.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Butcher
programme.desc: While Micki and Ryan are on vacation, Jack has nightmares of his World War II experience when he was captured by the Nazis and nearly killed by Rausch, a commandant known as The Butcher.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Crippled Inside
programme.desc: Fleeing fraternity boys who plan to attack her, a figure skater is hit by a car and crippled. However, a mysterious old man sells her an antique wheelchair at a garage sale.

programme.title: Isabelle
programme.desc: Isabelle tar opp arven fra 'Rosemary's Baby' og 'Eksorsisten'. Et vanlig amerikansk ektepar flytter inn i et perfekt villastrøk i New England. Men drømmen om å starte et lykkelig familieliv blir snart knust.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: For nearly 200 years, the Jailer’s Inn housed prisoners, many of whom were involved in the city’s bustling Bourbon trade. The Team visits with the Inn’s manager to learn about notable inmates like Jesse James.

programme.title: Humanoids From The Deep
programme.desc: Scientific experiments backfire and produce horrific mutations: half man, half fish, which terrorize a small fishing village by killing the men and raping the women.

programme.title: The Tomb Of Ligeia
programme.desc: Vincent Price is a man haunted by his past. In this case, the past comes in the form of his now-deceased first wife Ligeia, who casts a shadow over an ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns in the form of a black cat.

programme.title: The Duellists
programme.desc: Keith Carradine og Harvey Keitel har hovedrollene i denne dramatiske filmen om to offiserer i Napoleons hær som møter hverandre på brutalt vis i en rekke dueller.

programme.title: Tilfellet Henry
programme.desc: Henry er en vellykket advokat som må vinne for enhver pris, selv på familiens bekostning. Men et pistolskudd setter en stopper for Henrys karriere, lammer ham og fjerner alle minner om livet han hadde før.

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: Når den korrupte romerske lederen Tiberius med en stor hær forsøker å gjøre krav på Silkeveien, må Huo An og hans gruppe trente krigere alliere seg med en elitehær av romerske soldater ledet av general Lucius.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinne som bor på gatene i New York, møter den kloke inuitten Theo, som har blitt sendt til New York av sine "eldste" for å levere et budskap til verden.

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Forbered deg på ukontrollerbare latterkramper og kvalmebølger når gutta kaster sine forslåtte kropper inn i en rekke absurde situasjoner.Jackass Number Two det er en komedie du vil se igjen og igjen.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Vampire Zombies From Space!
programme.desc: Fra verdensrommets dyp har Dracula laget sin ondeste plan hittil: å forvandle Marlow til en hær av vampyr-zombier. En broket gruppe helter må kjempe for å redde verden.

programme.title: Tetsuo II: Body Hammer
programme.desc: Tre år etter Metal Fetisjistens forvandling ser kontorarbeideren Taniguchi Tomoo verden falle sammen når skinheads kidnapper sønnen hans. Tvunget til å frigjøre sin destruktive kraft, forvandles han til en grusom symbiose av metall og vev.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går undercover for å undersøke uforklarlige dødsfall i fengselet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Arbeidet som konsulenter for en arkeologisk eventyrfilm, innser Sydney og Nigel at farao Amun IIs 'rekvisitter' er ekte, lenge tenkte tapte relikvier. Hvordan kan de være?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia oppdager at hun var Cleopatras tjener i et tidligere liv da hun opplever déjà vu mens hun så på en katalog fra en antikkegyptisk relikvieutstilling.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney og studenten Adam er på forfedrenes fantastiske Eyes of Toklamanee, men de forfølges av mystiske våpenmenn.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i bakhold i Russland. To uker senere våkner Sydney i huset til en mann som heter Tsarlov, som hevder å ha reddet henne.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.desc: Bob and Millie wake up to find they are in a strange town. Everything appears to be props - trees, animals even cars.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Beverly D'Angelo, Sally Struthers, Melissa George
programme.desc: Beverly D'Angelo invokes Cass Elliot's spirit in her new home; Sally Struthers is visited by the apparition of a woman who fell tragically to her death in her home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Brett Butler, Cassandra Peterson, Phil Varone, Ana Gasteyer
programme.desc: A protective spirit saves Brett Butler from an abusive relationship; a murdered man threatens Cassandra Peterson's life in her own home; lonely spirits stalk Phil Varone.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Keisha Knight Pulliam, Ming-Na, Chi McBride, Mia Tyler
programme.desc: Keisha Knight Pulliam encounters a lingering family spirit; while making renovations on her new house, Ming-Na discovers a previous owner is reluctant to leave.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Best of Special
programme.desc: A "Best Of" one hour special. Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost; Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Elizabethtown
programme.desc: Den fremadstormende designeren Drew Baylor får livet snudd på hodet en skjebnesvanger dag. På vei til Elizabethtown møter Drew Claire, som har bestemt seg for at hun er den rette jenta for å vise Drew veien hjem igjen.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: I fremtiden deler menneskene hvert aspekt av livene sine med sofistikerte ledsagerroboter. Men da et robotbarn ved navn Davis programmeres til å vise betingelsesløs kjærlighet, er ikke menneskefamilien hans forberedt på konsekvensene.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Advokaten MattMurdock er blind, menhans resterende firesanser er overmenneskeligskarpe. Omdagen representererMurdock de undertrykte,men om natten er hanDaredevil.

programme.title: Biker Boyz
programme.desc: Smoke, ""Kongen av Cali"" - er den ubeseirede og overlegne racermesteren. Hans dominans og tittel blir utfordret av Kid, et ungt vindunderbarn, i en fengslede historie om moderne våghalser i det ultimate kappløp for å vinne den rasketes rett.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: I idylliske Port Isaac hører Danny tilfeldigvis koret Fisherman's Friends, bestående av ti ekte fiskere. Danny jobber for et plateselskap, og bestemmer seg for å signere koret, men å signere ti røffe fiskere viser seg å være lettere sagt en gjort.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: advarsel: denne helt nye filmen inkluderer helt nytt innhold som er uklippet, skandaløst og fullstendig upassende! Bad Grandpa .5 gir deg et helt nytt perspektiv på Irving Zismans verden med utrolige bonusscener og morsomme skøyerstreker.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris, og Justin Long serverer latter når unge servitører og servitriser søker etter meningen ved livet, kjærligheten, og vennskap i denne hysteriske komedien.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: En mann flytter med kona og datteren fra storbyen til sitt drømmehus i utkanten av en småby, langt unna all kommunikasjon. Timingen kunne imidlertid vært bedre da det viser seg at verden holder på å kollapse.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal
programme.desc: Beautiful Sophia Loren is the Austrian princess who, despite her exile from the familial estate scorns her mother's wish to marry a prince.

programme.title: Andromeda: Mayflies dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drift, men de blir snart til zombier som blir kontrollert av en bikube.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelen er nå tre
programme.desc: Motoren til skapelsen er i stand til å omskrive universet i henhold til eierens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må skaffe det før noen med mørke planer får det.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ting vi ikke kan endre
programme.desc: Et svart hull slår Dylan ut og sender ham inn i en alternativ virkelighet med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Unknown
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en av de tapt grunnleggerne av Commonwealth, men oppdager at hun kan være mer trøbbel enn hun er verdt.

programme.title: Mutant X: Under the Cloak of War
programme.desc: Shalimar blir sendt undercover i en dødelig høyteknologisk attentatring, for å finne hvorfor de vil ha Adam død.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Heist
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Hanover Haunting
programme.desc: For the first time, our cameras step inside an actively haunted house to hear two victims' terrifying testimony of paranormal activity.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Truth or Dare and The Morgue
programme.desc: A teenage girl agrees to spend a night in one of America's most haunted locations, and she filmed the whole thing to prove it.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Hitchhiker and The Widow
programme.desc: Strange things happen after a girl and her friends pick up a hitchhiker in the woods.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Don't Fall Asleep and The Double Walker
programme.desc: A woman starts to mimic the bizarre behavior that led to her fiance's mysterious death. A couple experiences the horrifying legend of the Double Walker firsthand.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Other Woman
programme.desc: En hjärtevärmande film om kärlek, sorg och försoning. Med Natalie Portman.

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Kirurgen Steven verkar utåt sett lycklig med sin familj, men är samtidigt bäste vän med sextonårige Martin som verkar ha någon hållhake på sin vän; frågan är vad den udda vänskapen grundar sig i, och vad den kan få för konsekvenser.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv är i fullständigt fritt fall. Hennes döttrar driver henne till vansinne och hennes otacksamma chef håller på köra slut på henne samtidigt som hennes man lämnar henne.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: Amy Schumer spelar rollen som Renee, en ung kvinna som varje dag febrilt försöker övervinna sin osäkerhet och sin känsla av otillräcklighet.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Bryan Mills och hans fru är i Istanbul när de blir kidnappade. Mannen som håller dom som gisslan visar sig vara far till en av de män som tidigare kidnappat Mills dotter, och som han under fritagandet av dottern dödat.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusionen om majestät
programme.desc: En felaktig sväng efter att ha lämnat en glidström skickar Andromeda in i Prolon-systemet. De räddar en flyktkapsel från en säker katastrof, men stoltheten vill ha den tillbaka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Idolernas skymning
programme.desc: Besättningen letar efter en förlorad koloni av Nietzscheanerna och upptäcker en annan besättning som i hemlighet har hjälpt dem.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hon har blivit oskadliggjord
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet upptäcker att deras lagkamrat Lexa är föremål för ett hemligt experiment som kontrollerar henne och ger sig ut på jakt efter den ansvariga läkaren.

programme.title: Mutant X: Drömälskare
programme.desc: Mutant X måste stoppa en vetenskapsman från att klona kvinnor för att använda dem som slavar i sin ultraexklusiva mansklubb.

programme.title: Mutant X: Profetian
programme.desc: Brennan kämpar tillsammans med en av profetians väktare för att stoppa den avlidne mutanten Ashlockes plan fra bortom världsherraväldens grav.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: RENO 911!: President Bush in Reno

programme.title: RENO 911!: Accidental Marriage

programme.title: RENO 911!: Milkshake Man's Death

programme.title: RENO 911!: Revenge of Mike Powers

programme.title: RENO 911!: Cop School

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Gift

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Travis Tritt

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Harry Lennix
programme.desc: Actor Harry Lennix (The Blacklist, Dollhouse, The Matrix Reloaded) returns to the notoriously haunted hotel in Eureka Springs, Arkansas.

programme.desc: Orange Is The New Black's Alysia Reiner begs for Psychic Medium Kim Russo's help in confronting spirits in her Harlem Brownstone that are terrorizing her young daughter.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Harlan County Courthouse was both sanctuary and execution site. The town hub that witnessed a brutal revenge killing and countless trials of corrupt lawmen is the site of the country's most haunted building.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårt arbetande mamma tar med sina barn på en utmanande roadtrip efter mannens svek.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: Mousehunt

programme.title: Chloe & Theo

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: The Big White

programme.title: Certified Copy

programme.desc: Lexas misstankar leder till att Mutant X avslöjar ett resande dödsläger som är utformat som en cirkus för mutantflyktingar och Mutant X:s fiende inom Dominion.

programme.title: Mutant X: Överfallet

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater

programme.title: Chris Voth
programme.desc: Chris Voth is an accomplished comedian, a licensed teacher, and a published author. Voth made his debut late-night television appearance on the Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson. He also appeared in three seasons of NBC's Last Comic Standing and was chosen for the prestigious Great American Comedy Festival. A 15-year comedy veteran, Voth is a past winner of the Denver Comedy Works Competition and has worked with everyone from Dave Chappelle to Larry the Cable Guy to Linda Ronstadt. Voth's first comedy CD titled "Never Mind the Jim J Bullocks, Here's the Chris Voth" is currently available for purchase. Chris currently balances his performance schedule with his full-time high-school teaching career. You can read his short story, "Stand Up and Deliver," published in the Cream City Review Literary Journal. In it, Chris shares the experiences he had when entering the teaching field after years in stand-up comedy.

programme.title: Andy Hendrickson

Internationally, Andy has performed at clubs and festivals throughout the world, including Canada, England, Holland, and Ireland. He also performed for our troops on Outback's Feeding Freedom Tour that provided entertainment for the troops on military bases across Afghanistan.

programme.title: Keith Stubbs
programme.desc: Keith Stubbs is a 'triple threat' in showbiz and entertainment. He's a hilarious stand-up comedian, talented actor, and award-winning radio personality.Keith was twice voted 'Best Comedian' by City Weekly, the Standard-Examiner named him 'Funniest Comic' and he was a semi-finalist in Comedy Central's Laugh Riots comedy competition. The Utah-based comic has made television appearances on A&E's An Evening at the Improv, nationally syndicated Comedy.TV, ABC's America's Funniest People and has established himself as a funny, improvisational comic, host, roastmaster and emcee.Keith tours nationally and has shared the stage with showbiz legends Joan Rivers, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Cosby, Jim Gaffigan, Sinbad, Gladys Knight, and Frank Caliendo. Keith was one of five comedians who performed for the athletes in the Olympic Village at the 2002 Winter Games.Keith was named Best Actor by City Weekly for his show-stopping, comedic performance as 'Vinnie Black' in the stage production of Tony 'n Tina's Wedding. Stubbs currently plays Rob Schneider's accountant in the TV series "Real Rob" on Netflix.For eight consecutive years, Keith was awarded "Best Radio Personality" by the Utah Broadcasters' Association for his time spent as host of "The Stubbs Show" on 101.5 The Eagle. He also hosted KEITH STUBBS SPORTS on ESPN700 in Salt Lake City and appeared nationally on CMT radio and the Blue Collar Comedy channel on SiriusXM.Keith is often recognized for being a clean comedian, although his audiences span a broad spectrum. One review said, "Keith was funny, period! He was clean but we hardly noticed because his comedy and style are so unique and spot on."

programme.title: Key Lewis
programme.sub-title: Half Black, Half White, Looks Mexican
programme.desc: Sacramento California born Key Lewis is a high energy, improvisational, storytelling, multiple-personality nutcase! His love for the people and hunger for the stage is his undying motivation. His comedic stories about his interracial childhood, family, and unusual views on relationships, make Key simply a joy to watch. His ability to improvise and interact with all types of crowds makes this up and coming comic and actor one to look out for. Key Lewis has appeared on Marlon Wayans TBSís Funniest Wins, Starz Networks StaannDup, Kevin Harts One Mic Stand as well as Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes! Key says, chase your dream, always know your audience donít act funny, be funny... donít worry about the quantity of your material but the quality the sooner you create a relationship with your crowd, the better you will be. Television: Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes on TVONE. BETíS One Mic Stand Hosted by Kevin Hart. Starz Network Comedy Series called StaannDup, Marlon Wayanís TBSís Funniest Wins! Competitions: Winner of the 2013 Rocky Mountain Laugh Off, Finalist in the 2010 Bay Area Black Comedy Competition, Semi-Finalist 2009 San Francisco International Comedy Competition, a Semi-Finalist in the 2008 Boston Comedy Festival, 2007 Seattle International Comedy Competition Finalist, Shades of Laughs Portland Oregon Winner, TVONE Bill Bellamyís Who Got Jokeís Contestant. Radio: Improv work with FM Morning Shows (Top 40 Radio): KSFM 102.5 (Sacramento, CA), KWOD 106.5 (Sacramento, CA) KWIN 97.7 ñ Stockton/Lodi, CA, Mix 107.9 Salt Lake City UT (Is It Racist Segment) & The Man Panel. Concerts/Festivals: Opened for Jon B. and Keysha Cole, Taste Of Tacoma, & Bite Of Seattle Fountain Stage 5 Years Running! Key Lewis has worked with the likes of Kevin Hart, Pablo Francisco, Sam Bam, Alonzo Bodden, Jay London, Gabriel Iglesias, Brooks McBeth, Tommy Davidson, Katt Williams, De-Ray Davis, Andrew Norelli, Lonnie Love, Jeff Garcia, Damon Wayans, Joey Diaz, Guy Torry, Darren Carter, Paul Mooney, Kermet Apio and many more.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other.
